name: SocialDataX
tagline: Hosted social-media research MCP servers and sensitive-content checking.
description: SocialDataX (社媒数据助手) provides hosted MCP services for fourteen social platforms and sensitive-content checking. Users supply their own SocialDataX API Key. Business calls consume SocialDataX credits; checking the points balance is free. SocialDataX operates these services independently and is not an official service of the social platforms.

methods.label: SocialDataX API Key
methods.note: Each user supplies their own key in the Authorization Bearer header. Anonymous tool discovery does not grant authenticated business access.

auth.guide: Create an account and obtain your own API Key at [SocialDataX](https://socialdatax.com/ai?from=integrations-sh). Store it as SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY. Connect to the selected Streamable HTTP endpoint and send `Authorization: Bearer <SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY>` on requests. Business calls consume SocialDataX credits; the points-balance tool is free. Use the connection README for the selected service.
